description: Completeness report: for each optional field of the registry (rnb_id, frpv_proba, false_positive, false_positive_source), how many detections have it filled in and what percentage. Answers "how many installations have an RNB id / an FRPV comparison / a false-positive flag?" in one call, for France or one département. For a single filtered count use count_detections instead. Null means "not available/recorded", never "0" or "confirmed ok". Data quality note: this is a detection dataset, not an exhaustive inventory (estimated recall ~0.6). A missing detection does not mean no PV installation exists there. kwp, surface, tilt and azimuth are model estimates, not surveyed values. In this server, quality_filter=true keeps only detections identified by 2 or more sources (see source_encoding in get_data_quality_reference). Call get_data_quality_reference for the full picture before assessing fitness for a specific use case.
